variants.title: Give each part its job
variants.context: Federated learning is a way to train a shared model across many data owners without first copying their raw examples into one training store. A coordinator distributes a model and a round contract, selected clients train locally, and the coordinator combines bounded updates into the next global model.
variants.prompt: Match each part to its responsibility.

pairs.label: Select an eligible cohort
pairs.detail: Filter by consent, software and model version, power and network policy, geography, availability, rate limits, and sampling goals.
pairs.explanation: Filter by consent, software and model version, power and network policy, geography, availability, rate limits, and sampling goals.

pairs.label: Train within a client contract
pairs.detail: Verify the model and task, load local examples, run bounded work, clip the contribution, and report only approved metrics and update material.
pairs.explanation: Verify the model and task, load local examples, run bounded work, clip the contribution, and report only approved metrics and update material.

pairs.label: Recover a valid aggregate
pairs.detail: Authenticate participants, reject incompatible schemas, tolerate bounded dropout, and unmask only after the secure-aggregation survivor threshold is met.
pairs.explanation: Authenticate participants, reject incompatible schemas, tolerate bounded dropout, and unmask only after the secure-aggregation survivor threshold is met.

pairs.label: Evaluate before release
pairs.detail: Check global and cohort quality, privacy accounting, integrity canaries, fairness, rollback criteria, and artifact lineage before canary deployment.
pairs.explanation: Check global and cohort quality, privacy accounting, integrity canaries, fairness, rollback criteria, and artifact lineage before canary deployment.

pairs.label: Cross-device federation
pairs.detail: Phones, browsers, vehicles, or edge devices participate briefly.
pairs.explanation: Phones, browsers, vehicles, or edge devices participate briefly. The design emphasizes anonymous or pseudonymous sampling, energy and network policy, high dropout, small per-client weight, and large secure-aggregation cohorts.

pairs.label: Cross-silo federation
pairs.detail: Hospitals, banks, regions, or business units train on managed infrastructure.
pairs.explanation: Hospitals, banks, regions, or business units train on managed infrastructure. The design emphasizes identity, contracts, schema alignment, organization-level weighting, governance, and auditable site-specific quality.

pairs.label: FedAvg
pairs.detail: Average client deltas, commonly by bounded local sample count.
pairs.explanation: Average client deltas, commonly by bounded local sample count. It is simple and communication-efficient, but local objectives can drift apart on non-IID data.

pairs.label: FedProx
pairs.detail: Add a proximal term to each local objective so a client is penalized for moving too far from the current global model.
pairs.explanation: Add a proximal term to each local objective so a client is penalized for moving too far from the current global model.

pairs.label: SCAFFOLD
pairs.detail: Maintain control variates that correct client and server update directions.
pairs.explanation: Maintain control variates that correct client and server update directions. This can reduce drift but adds client state and communication.

pairs.label: Personalized federation
pairs.detail: Share a representation or initialization while retaining local heads, adapters, normalization, or fine-tuning when one global optimum is not appropriate.
pairs.explanation: Share a representation or initialization while retaining local heads, adapters, normalization, or fine-tuning when one global optimum is not appropriate.

variants.title: Give each part its job
variants.context: Federated learning is a way to train a shared model across many data owners without first copying their raw examples into one training store. A coordinator distributes a model and a round contract, selected clients train locally, and the coordinator combines bounded updates into the next global model.
variants.prompt: Match each part to its responsibility.

pairs.label: Authenticated transport
pairs.detail: Encrypt and authenticate client-coordinator traffic, bind messages to a round and model version, rotate credentials, and prevent replay.
pairs.explanation: Encrypt and authenticate client-coordinator traffic, bind messages to a round and model version, rotate credentials, and prevent replay. Transport alone does not hide updates from the coordinator.

pairs.label: Secure aggregation
pairs.detail: Recover only a threshold aggregate while masking individual surviving updates.
pairs.explanation: Recover only a threshold aggregate while masking individual surviving updates. Define setup, dropout recovery, abort, and transcript-retention behavior.

pairs.label: Differential privacy
pairs.detail: Clip contributions, add calibrated noise, and compose privacy loss with a trusted accountant.
pairs.explanation: Clip contributions, add calibrated noise, and compose privacy loss with a trusted accountant. It bounds leakage; it does not authenticate clients or stop poisoning.

pairs.label: Integrity controls
pairs.detail: Use eligibility, identity or attestation, rate limits, bounded influence, aggregate anomaly checks, poisoning canaries, staged release, and rollback.
pairs.explanation: Use eligibility, identity or attestation, rate limits, bounded influence, aggregate anomaly checks, poisoning canaries, staged release, and rollback.
